motion.componentBoardHeader: States: rest, hover (fill/hover), pressed (fill/selected), focus (2 px accent ring, 2 px offset), disabled (40% opacity), loading (spinner replaces icon, width kept). Motion: 83 ms hover, 167 ms press/fade, decelerate curve.

icons.set: Tabler outline, MIT; masters are 24x24 components named "Icon / <name>" on page "Foundations & components" (id 40210)
icons.finding: Every icon instance in the file (12 to 63 px, 5,000+ instances) keeps stroke weight 1.5 px; the geometry is scaled (16 px icon = 24 px geometry x 2/3) but the stroke is NOT scaled. A 16 px icon therefore has a 1.5 px stroke on screen, which is 2.25 in the 24-unit viewBox. In SVG with viewBox "0 0 24 24" use stroke-width = 1.5 * 24 / renderedSize (2.25 at 16, 2.571 at 14, 3 at 12, 2 at 18, 1.8 at 20) or vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke with stroke-width 1.5.

sizesObserved.12: status pill, pill icons, window buttons, logo glyph
sizesObserved.14: tab/segmented icons, select chevron, menu check, approval header
sizesObserved.16: buttons, inputs, menu items, toast, composer actions (default)

icons.placement: Icon boxes are centred: in a 32 px button the 16 px icon sits at (12, 8) = vertically centred and exactly level with the 16 px text box (dyFromTextCentre 0); in a 36 px circular composer button at (10, 10); in a 36 px high input at (13, 10). Frames are auto-layout (cross axis centre), so icon centre = frame centre; text boxes use the line-height heights above, never the icon box.

tokens.layoutModel: All frames use box-sizing border-box with strokes included in the size (layout.strokes_included = true). Strokes default to 1 px inside. "Hug" = content size, "fill" = flex 1, "fixed" = explicit px.

statesRules.hover: fill/hover overlay on ghost/secondary/icon/menu/nav/row; primary button hover = tag/blue (#4A9EFF dark, #0A6ED1 light); input hover = stroke text/tertiary

statesRules.selected: fill/selected (nav item, toggle button on, segmented option, palette active row)
statesRules.focus: accent/default stroke: 2 px outside on buttons/pills (drawn offset 0, although the board header says 2 px offset), 2 px inside on text input and hotkey recorder, 1 px inside on composer
statesRules.disabled: opacity 0.4 on buttons, inputs, toggles, radios, menu items; 0.5 on composer and excluded source card
statesRules.loading: loader-2 icon replaces the leading icon, label and width unchanged
statesRules.danger: tag/red text (ghost danger) or tag/red fill with text-on-accent (confirmed destructive); error border tag/red 1 px inside
